title: A Day at the Pond
subtitle: There is a lot to notice
description: A quiet pond, a busy duck, and a surprise in the reeds. Get ready, read a short story, then try a few activities.

pages.title: Before you read
pages.text:
Think of a pond.
What might you see there?

Look out for these words in the story:
pond · duck · reeds · frog
pages.note: Take your time. You don’t need to write an answer here.

pages.title: At the pond
pages.text:
Ben and Nan sit by the pond.
A duck dips its head in the water.
“Look at that!” says Ben.
The duck pops back up.

pages.title: A sound in the reeds
pages.text:
A frog sits in the reeds.
It hops onto a rock.
Ben is still. Nan is still.
They watch the frog hop back in.

pages.title: True or false?
pages.instructions: Decide whether each sentence matches the story.

questions.prompt: The duck dips its head in the water.
questions.hint: Look at what the duck does on the first story page.

questions.prompt: The frog sits in a bag.
questions.hint: Find the frog at the start of the second story page.

pages.title: Make a match
pages.instructions: Match each animal to what it does in the story.

questions.prompt: Ben and Nan sit by the ___.
questions.hint: The title gives you a clue.

pages.title: Put the story in order
pages.instructions: Drag a sentence to its place, or use each numbered menu. Start with what happens first.
